SLAYTHEREQUIEM-RUSTY_CLEAVER.title: Rusty Cleaver
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-RUSTY_CLEAVER.description:
Weapon (sword I). Weapon attacks +1 damage. [gold]Sharp[/gold]: every 3rd weapon attack deals ×1.5.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SMUGGLER_DAGGER.title: Smuggler's Dagger
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SMUGGLER_DAGGER.descripti:
Weapon (dagger I). Weapon attacks cost 1 less ◆. [gold]Sneaky[/gold]: ×1.5 vs enemies not intending to attack, Bleed 1; sneaky hits refund 1 ◆.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-WOODCUTTER_AXE.title: Woodcutter's Axe
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-WOODCUTTER_AXE.descriptio:
Weapon (axe I). Weapon attacks +1 damage. [gold]Chopping[/gold]: +2 vs enemies below 50% HP. Sells for more.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-WOODCUTTER_AXE.flavor: A tool first, a weapon second.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-IRON_MACE.title: Iron Mace
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-IRON_MACE.description:
Weapon (mace I). Weapon attacks +1 damage. [gold]Crushing[/gold]: Sunder 1 per hit.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STEEL_WARHAMMER.title: Steel Warhammer
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STEEL_WARHAMMER.descripti:
Two-handed weapon (II). Weapon attacks +4 damage and cost 1 more ◆. Crushing ×2, Stagger 2 per hit.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SILVER_SABER.title: Silver Saber
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SILVER_SABER.description:
Weapon (sword III). Weapon attacks +3 damage, +2 more vs undead and spirits. Sharp.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-EVERFROST_HAMMER.title: Everfrost Hammer
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-EVERFROST_HAMMER.descript:
Weapon (mace V). Weapon attacks +4 damage. Crushing ×2; each hit applies Chill 2.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OAK_SHIELD.title: Oak Shield
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OAK_SHIELD.description:
Off-hand shield. Block from cards +1.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MILITIA_HELM.title: Militia Helm
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MILITIA_HELM.description:
Heavy armor (I). Set [gold]Militia Iron[/gold]: 2 — Plating +1; 4 — 5 Block at combat start.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MILITIA_CUIRASS.title: Militia Cuirass
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MILITIA_CUIRASS.descripti:
Heavy armor (I). Set [gold]Militia Iron[/gold]: 2 — Plating +1; 4 — 5 Block at combat start.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MILITIA_GAUNTLETS.title: Militia Gauntlets
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MILITIA_GAUNTLETS.descrip:
Heavy armor (I). Set [gold]Militia Iron[/gold]: 2 — Plating +1; 4 — 5 Block at combat start.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MILITIA_GREAVES.title: Militia Greaves
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MILITIA_GREAVES.descripti:
Heavy armor (I). Set [gold]Militia Iron[/gold]: 2 — Plating +1; 4 — 5 Block at combat start.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STALKER_HOOD.title: Stalker Hood
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STALKER_HOOD.description:
Light armor (I). Set [gold]Stalker Hides[/gold]: 2 — +1 max ◆, Dodge 1; 4 — first attack each combat +3.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STALKER_JERKIN.title: Stalker Jerkin
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STALKER_JERKIN.descriptio:
Light armor (I). Set [gold]Stalker Hides[/gold]: 2 — +1 max ◆, Dodge 1; 4 — first attack each combat +3.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STALKER_GLOVES.title: Stalker Gloves
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STALKER_GLOVES.descriptio:
Light armor (I). Set [gold]Stalker Hides[/gold]: 2 — +1 max ◆, Dodge 1; 4 — first attack each combat +3.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STALKER_BOOTS.title: Stalker Boots
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STALKER_BOOTS.description:
Light armor (I). Set [gold]Stalker Hides[/gold]: 2 — +1 max ◆, Dodge 1; 4 — first attack each combat +3.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STAR_ACADEMY_ROBE.title: Star Academy Robe
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-STAR_ACADEMY_ROBE.descrip:
Robe (body). [gold]Ward[/gold] 4: the first 4 HP damage each turn is paid with ✦.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FIRST_BLIZZARD_CLOAK.desc:
Cloak. Frost Resistance I.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-RING_OF_STAMINA.title: Ring of Stamina
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-RING_OF_STAMINA.descripti:
Ring. Start each combat with 2 more ◆ (up to max).
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-RING_OF_MAGICKA.title: Ring of Magicka
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-RING_OF_MAGICKA.descripti:
Ring. Gain 1 ✦ at the start of each turn after the first.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-GRIMOIRE.title: Grimoire
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-GRIMOIRE.description: Holds your mastery of the five schools of magic. Spells above your mastery cost more ✦; far above — only from scrolls.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-TREATISE_OF_ALTERATION.fl: The letters rearrange when you blink.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-TREATISE_OF_CONJURATION.f: Something on the other side reads along.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-TREATISE_OF_ILLUSION.flav: You are sure it had more pages.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-HIGHBORN_ORIGIN.title: Highborn
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-HIGHBORN_ORIGIN.descripti: Max ✦ +3, Max HP −5. The first spell each turn costs 1 less ✦. [gold]Magic weakness I[/gold].
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-HIGHBORN_ORIGIN.flavor: Starlight runs thinner in other veins.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MISTBORN_ORIGIN.title: Mistborn
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MISTBORN_ORIGIN.descripti: Max ◆ +1. [gold]Magic resistance I[/gold]. The first enemy spell each combat is absorbed.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ASHBORN_ORIGIN.title: Ashborn
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ASHBORN_ORIGIN.flavor: Born under a red mountain, raised on its ash.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FROSTBORN_ORIGIN.title: Frostborn
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FROSTBORN_ORIGIN.descript: Max HP +5, capacity +2. [gold]Frost resistance I[/gold]; [gold]Chill[/gold] on you wears off at once.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MOONBORN_ORIGIN.title: Moonborn
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MOONBORN_ORIGIN.descripti: Max ◆ +1. [gold]Night Eyes[/gold]: unarmed weapon attacks (claws) apply 1 [gold]Bleed[/gold], like a dagger.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MOONBORN_ORIGIN.flavor: The Spire is never quite dark to them.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-THICKETBORN_ORIGIN.title: Thicketborn
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-THICKETBORN_ORIGIN.descri: Max HP −5, capacity +3. [gold]Blight resistance II[/gold]. Beasts don't attack on the first turn.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-THICKETBORN_ORIGIN.flavor: The wolves nod as you pass.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MARSHBORN_ORIGIN.title: Marshborn
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MARSHBORN_ORIGIN.descript: Max HP +5. [gold]Poison resistance I[/gold], [gold]Blight resistance II[/gold]. Below 50% HP heal 2 at turn start (below 25% — 4).
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MARSHBORN_ORIGIN.flavor: The swamp keeps what it loves.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-VAGRANT_BACKGROUND.title: Vagrant
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-VAGRANT_BACKGROUND.descri: Max HP +5, ◆ +1, ✦ +1, capacity +3. Remove a card at the start of the run.
Each combat begins with a free spirit beast (wolf → sabrecat → bear as you slay elites).
It answers to no name you could say.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SKALD_BACKGROUND.title: Skald
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SKALD_BACKGROUND.flavor: Every saga needs a first verse.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FROSTBINDER_BACKGROUND.de: [gold]Ice Wind[/gold] replaces a Strike. Aura: enemies are vulnerable to frost (I).
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FROSTBINDER_BACKGROUND.fl: Breath that hangs in the air.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FUGITIVE_BACKGROUND.title: Fugitive
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FUGITIVE_BACKGROUND.descr: Attacks deal +1 damage for each 0-cost card played this turn (max +3).
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ROGUE_BACKGROUND.title: Rogue
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ROGUE_BACKGROUND.flavor: Nothing is stolen until it's missed.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DUSK_SINGER_BACKGROUND.de: +1 Restoration mastery. Start with a [gold]Moon Sugar Elixir[/gold].
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-WINDDANCER_BACKGROUND.des: Attacks deal +1 damage for every 3rd card played this turn.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-HUNTER_BACKGROUND.title: Hunter
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-HERMIT_BACKGROUND.title: Hermit
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-HERMIT_BACKGROUND.descrip: After each combat gain 1 reagent (Bloodmoss or Nightcap).
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-HERMIT_BACKGROUND.flavor: The mushrooms talk, if you listen.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-GLADIATOR_BACKGROUND.desc: Heal 1 at the start of your turn. Start with a [gold]Rejuvenation Potion I[/gold].
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-GLADIATOR_BACKGROUND.flav: The crowd still chants your name.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHADOWSCALE_BACKGROUND.de: [gold]From the Shadows[/gold]: your first attack each combat deals ×2 and costs no ◆.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-JUSTICIAR_BACKGROUND.desc: Each combat begins with a free storm atronach.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SHADOW_SORCERER_BACKGROUN: Did you see that? Neither did they.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-WIZARD_BACKGROUND.title: Wizard
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-WIZARD_BACKGROUND.descrip: Spells deal +1 damage for each 25% of ✦ pool you are missing.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-KNIGHT_BACKGROUND.title: Knight
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-KNIGHT_BACKGROUND.flavor: The oath grows heavier as you bleed.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SUMMONER_BACKGROUND.title: Summoner
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SUMMONER_BACKGROUND.descr: Summons +5 HP and +1 damage. [gold]Conjure Spirit Wolf[/gold] replaces a Strike.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MUSHROOM_TOWER_BACKGROUND: [gold]Firebolt[/gold] replaces a Strike. Aura: enemies are vulnerable to fire (I).
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-HERBALIST_POUCH.title: Herbalist's Pouch
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-HERBALIST_POUCH.descripti:
Holds up to 12 reagents (weight 0). Victories yield reagents by enemy kind. [gold]Brew[/gold] potions and poisons at rest sites. +2 potion slots (poison belt).
Bloodmoss {Bloodmoss}, Bluebloom {Bluebloom}, Yellow sorrel {Yellowsorrel}, Ash salt {AshSalt}, Frost salt {FrostSalt}, Storm crystal {StormCrystal}, Nightcap {Nightcap}, Grave dust {GraveDust}, Dragon scale {DragonScale}, Fragrant tear {FragrantTear}.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-TRAVEL_PACK.title: Travel Pack
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-TRAVEL_PACK.description: Burden: {Weight} / {Capacity} (overload {Excess}). Overload 1–5: −1 ◆ regen; 6–10: also −1 opening card; over 10: you can't pick up cards. Camp chest: {Stored} items.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-TRAVEL_PACK.flavor: Everything you own, minus what you left behind.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SCALED_DAGGER.title: Scaled Dagger
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SCALED_DAGGER.description:
Weapon (dagger III). Weapon attacks cost 1 less ◆. [gold]Sneaky[/gold]: ×1.5, Bleed 1; sneaky hits restore 1 ✦.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SCALED_DAGGER.flavor: Scales of something that is no longer hungry.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-TWILIGHT_WIDOW_BLADE.desc:
Artifact (dagger). [gold]Sneaky[/gold] ×2 instead of ×1.5. Killing with a weapon attack: [gold]Invisibility[/gold] until the end of your turn.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SMUGGLER_COIF.title: Smuggler's Coif
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SMUGGLER_COIF.description:
Light armor II. Set [gold]Smuggler's Mail[/gold]: 2 — +1 Dodge charge; 4 — after a Dodge your next attack is [gold]Sneaky[/gold].
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SMUGGLER_HAUBERK.title: Smuggler's Hauberk
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SMUGGLER_HAUBERK.descript:
Light armor II. Set [gold]Smuggler's Mail[/gold]: 2 — +1 Dodge charge; 4 — after a Dodge your next attack is [gold]Sneaky[/gold].
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SMUGGLER_HAUBERK.flavor: Quiet as a whisper, until it isn't.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SMUGGLER_BRACERS.title: Smuggler's Bracers
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SMUGGLER_BRACERS.descript:
Light armor II. Set [gold]Smuggler's Mail[/gold]: 2 — +1 Dodge charge; 4 — after a Dodge your next attack is [gold]Sneaky[/gold].
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SMUGGLER_BOOTS.title: Smuggler's Boots
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SMUGGLER_BOOTS.descriptio:
Light armor II. Set [gold]Smuggler's Mail[/gold]: 2 — +1 Dodge charge; 4 — after a Dodge your next attack is [gold]Sneaky[/gold].
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SMUGGLER_BOOTS.flavor: Soles worn by a thousand back alleys.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BOOTS_OF_SILENCE.title: Boots of Silence
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BOOTS_OF_SILENCE.descript:
Unique light armor (feet). Your attacks don't remove [gold]Invisibility[/gold].
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BOOTS_OF_SILENCE.flavor: You hear nothing. Neither do they.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MERCHANT_LEDGER.title: Merchant's Ledger
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MERCHANT_LEDGER.descripti: Remembers every shop. Trust here: {Trust} (−{Discount}% prices). Spend 150 gold in shops of a kind for +1 trust (max 3). Combat gold ×1.3. Close the shelf to open the counter: selling backpack gear, services, orders at trust 3.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MERCHANT_LEDGER.flavor: Debts in red, favours in gold.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MEMORY_STONE_RELIC.title: Requiem Candles
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MEMORY_STONE_RELIC.descri: At the start of each act the Memory Stone takes an Imprint of your run. On death you may return to it for a Candle and a Scar. Returns so far: {Rollbacks}.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MEMORY_STONE_RELIC.flavor: The Spire sings a requiem for every fallen. The stone remembers your name.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MERCHANT_LEDGER.sellBody: The merchant offers [gold]{Gold}[/gold] gold ({Percent}%) for the {Count} unequipped item(s) in your backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MEMORY_STONE_RELIC.offerB: Go back to the start of act {Act} for one Candle (left: {Candles}; −1 means unlimited). A new map, the same boss; choose a Scar as the price. Revenge: +10% damage to those who killed you.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MERCHANT_LEDGER.theftBody: You can't afford it ({Gold} gold). Chance to slip away: {Chance}%. If caught — the guards beat you (−20% max HP) and this kind of shop stops trusting you.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MEMORY_STONE_RELIC.coopOf: Offer a return to the Memory Stone?
The party votes on going back to the start of act {Act} for one shared Candle (left: {Candles}; −1 — unlimited). Ties are yours to break. Each player chooses their own Scar.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MEMORY_STONE_RELIC.coopVo: The host proposes going back to the start of act {Act} for one shared Candle (left: {Candles}; −1 — unlimited). A new map, the same boss; you will choose a Scar. After the vote, rejoin the host's lobby.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FAITH_SIGIL.title: Sigil of Faith
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FAITH_SIGIL.description:
Your righteousness: Righteous → Tainted → Apostate. Theft and robbery −1 step; a pact with a Prince of the Abyss — Apostate; Abyssal items keep you no higher than Tainted. Atonement at a Shrine: +1 step, once per act.
Shown number — current state (0 Righteous, 1 Tainted, 2 Apostate).
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FAITH_SIGIL.flavor: Light or shadow — the sigil remembers.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OMEN_OF_THE_BLADE.title: Omen of the Blade
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OMEN_OF_THE_BLADE.descrip: +6 max HP; attacks deal 1 more damage; +1 ◆ regeneration; being Tired does not reduce damage.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OMEN_OF_THE_BASTION.title: Omen of the Bastion
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OMEN_OF_THE_BASTION.descr: Plating +1; Fire, Frost and Shock Resistance I; Poise +3; the first Concussion each combat is ignored.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OMEN_OF_THE_EYE.title: Omen of the Eye
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OMEN_OF_THE_EYE.descripti: +2 max ✦, +1 ✦ regeneration, +1 to all spell schools. Aura: enemies get Magic vulnerability I.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OMEN_OF_THE_SPONGE.title: Omen of the Sponge
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OMEN_OF_THE_SPONGE.descri: +6 max ✦; Spell Absorption 1; Ward 2. Downside: −1 ✦ regeneration.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OMEN_OF_THE_SPONGE.flavor: The Atronach drinks, but cannot pour.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OMEN_OF_THE_RITE.title: Omen of the Rite
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OMEN_OF_THE_RITE.descript: +1 summon slot; Conjuration spells cost 1 less ✦.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OMEN_OF_THE_BURDEN.title: Omen of the Burden
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OMEN_OF_THE_BURDEN.descri: +10 Burden capacity; immune to Freeze, Paralysis and Shock; attacks cost at most 1 ◆.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OMEN_OF_THE_TRICKSTER.des: You may try [gold]Theft[/gold] in shops (once per visit, costs righteousness); gold gained +15%.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OMEN_OF_THE_VOICE.title: Omen of the Voice
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OMEN_OF_THE_VOICE.descrip: Shouts deal 3 more damage and recharge 1 turn faster; cards in shops are one rarity higher.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OMEN_OF_THE_VOICE.flavor: The Voice carries over the mountain.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OMEN_OF_THE_SHADE.title: Omen of the Shade
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OMEN_OF_THE_SHADE.descrip: Start each combat [gold]Invisible[/gold]: the first enemy attack against you misses; your attacks from Invisibility deal double damage.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OMEN_OF_THE_SERPENT.title: Omen of the Serpent
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-OMEN_OF_THE_SERPENT.descr: Poison you apply +1; Poison Resistance II; aura: enemies −I Poison resistance; weapon poisons hold 5 charges.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-EARTH_SHARD.title: Shard of Earth
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-EARTH_SHARD.description: Until the end of the act: +1 max ◆, Plating +1. Downside: −1 card in your opening hand.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ROOT_SHARD.title: Shard of Root
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ROOT_SHARD.description: Until the end of the act: Magic Resistance I, Poison Resistance II. Downside: Fire vulnerability.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BEAST_SHARD.title: Shard of the Beast
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BEAST_SHARD.description: Until the end of the act: attacks +2 damage, Pierce 1. Downside: physical attacks deal 1 more damage to you.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-WATER_SHARD.title: Shard of Water
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-WATER_SHARD.description: Until the end of the act: +3 max ✦, +1 ✦ regeneration. Downside: Shock vulnerability.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-WIND_SHARD.title: Shard of Wind
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-WIND_SHARD.description: Until the end of the act: +1 card in your opening hand, +1 ◆ regeneration. Downside: Plating −1.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SUN_SHARD.title: Shard of the Sun
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SUN_SHARD.description: Until the end of the act: +8 max HP, heal 1 at the start of each turn. Downside: Frost vulnerability.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-GIFT_OF_PLAGUE_LORD.title: Gift of the Plague Lord
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-GIFT_OF_PLAGUE_LORD.descr:
Gift: your attacks apply 1 [gold]Blight[/gold]; +1 ◆ regeneration. Price: a random Disease now and at the start of each act. Vow — kill 3 enemies under Blight: Diseases give their bonuses too.
Shown number — Vow progress.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-GIFT_OF_TWILIGHT_WIDOW.de:
Gift: start each combat [gold]Invisible[/gold]. Price: −5 max HP. Vow — win 2 combats without taking damage on the first turn: +1 ✦ regeneration and Invisibility lasts 2 turns.
Shown number — Vow progress.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-GIFT_OF_TWILIGHT_WIDOW.fl: Luck is a shadow that owes you.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-GIFT_OF_WEB_WEAVER.title: Gift of the Web Weaver
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-GIFT_OF_WEB_WEAVER.descri:
Gift: heal 1 for each attack hit on a poisoned enemy (up to 5 per turn). Price: resting heals 30% less. Vow — poison 3 elites: attacks deal 2 more damage to enemies below 50% HP.
Shown number — Vow progress.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-GIFT_OF_GATE_BREAKER.desc:
Gift: summons and Abyssal weapons deal 2 more damage; the first spell each turn costs 1 less ✦. Price: Apostate forever. Vow — kill an Abyss elite: aura — enemies get Fire vulnerability.
Shown number — Vow progress.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-GIFT_OF_TREACHERY.title: Gift of the Prince of Treachery
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-GIFT_OF_TREACHERY.descrip:
Gift: attacks deal 2 more damage, Pierce 1. Price: your summons take 50% more damage. Vow — win an elite fight with no summons: +1 card in your opening hand.
Shown number — Vow progress.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-GIFT_OF_REVEL.title: Gift of the Revel Prince
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-GIFT_OF_REVEL.description:
Gift: you may hold 2 Special foods at once (food arrives in Stage 5). Price: a [gold]Dazed[/gold] «Hangover» enters your hand at the start of each combat. Vow — drink 3 potions: drinks reveal their second properties (Stage 5).
Shown number — Vow progress.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-GIFT_OF_OUTCAST.title: Gift of the Outcast
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-GIFT_OF_OUTCAST.descripti:
Gift: heal 2 after each combat; heavy attacks (2+ ◆) deal 2 more damage. Price: righteousness is unavailable; shops are 15% more expensive. Vow — defeat a boss without potions: bonuses double.
Shown number — Vow progress.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-GIFT_OF_OUTCAST.flavor: Spite is a kind of strength.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-GIFT_OF_DUSK_STAR.title: Gift of the Dusk Star
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-GIFT_OF_DUSK_STAR.descrip:
Gift: +6 max HP, +2 max ✦; Fire and Frost Resistance I. Price: star marks — each combat that many random cards cost 1 more energy; one more mark each act. Vow — finish an act with no allies dying: the Price is lifted.
Shown number — Vow progress.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BLESSING_OF_WINGED_HOUR.d:
+2 max ◆; Fire Resistance I.
Righteous — full; Tainted — only the first bonus; Apostate — silent. With this god's Amulet: +1 ◆ regeneration. With his Robe: Fire Resistance I. All together + Heavenly Shield — Divine Spirit: Shouts recharge 1 turn faster.
Shown number — blessing strength (2 full, 1 dimmed, 0 silent).
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-AMULET_OF_WINGED_HOUR.des: Amulet of the god's set (Shrine, 120 gold). With the Blessing of Winged Hour while Righteous: +1 ◆ regeneration.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ROBE_OF_WINGED_HOUR.title: Robe of Winged Hour
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ROBE_OF_WINGED_HOUR.descr: Robe (body), [gold]Ward[/gold] 2 (Shrine, 150 gold). With the Blessing of Winged Hour while Righteous: Fire Resistance I.
+6 max HP; +1 ◆ regeneration.
Righteous — full; Tainted — only the first bonus; Apostate — silent. With this god's Amulet: Plating +1. With his Robe: Heavy attacks (2+ ◆) deal 2 more damage. All together + Heavenly Shield — Divine Spirit: Heavy attacks deal 3 more damage.
Shown number — blessing strength (2 full, 1 dimmed, 0 silent).
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-AMULET_OF_ANVIL_FATHER.de: Amulet of the god's set (Shrine, 120 gold). With the Blessing of Anvil Father while Righteous: Plating +1.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ROBE_OF_ANVIL_FATHER.desc: Robe (body), [gold]Ward[/gold] 2 (Shrine, 150 gold). With the Blessing of Anvil Father while Righteous: Heavy attacks (2+ ◆) deal 2 more damage.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BLESSING_OF_SCROLL_KEEPER:
+2 max ✦; +1 ✦ regeneration.
Righteous — full; Tainted — only the first bonus; Apostate — silent. With this god's Amulet: Start each combat with 2 more ✦. With his Robe: +2 max ✦. All together + Heavenly Shield — Divine Spirit: The first spell each turn is copied.
Shown number — blessing strength (2 full, 1 dimmed, 0 silent).
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-AMULET_OF_SCROLL_KEEPER.d: Amulet of the god's set (Shrine, 120 gold). With the Blessing of Scroll Keeper while Righteous: Start each combat with 2 more ✦.

SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BLESSING_OF_MIRROR_MAIDEN:
+1 ✦ regeneration; Spell Absorption 1.
Righteous — full; Tainted — only the first bonus; Apostate — silent. With this god's Amulet: Ward 2. With his Robe: Spell Absorption +1. All together + Heavenly Shield — Divine Spirit: Illusions and charms cost no ✦ once per turn.
Shown number — blessing strength (2 full, 1 dimmed, 0 silent).

SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BLESSING_OF_WIND_MISTRESS:
+1 ◆ and ✦ regeneration.
Righteous — full; Tainted — only the first bonus; Apostate — silent. With this god's Amulet: Poise +2. With his Robe: Poison Resistance I. All together + Heavenly Shield — Divine Spirit: Poison Resistance II.
Shown number — blessing strength (2 full, 1 dimmed, 0 silent).

Heal 2 at the start of each of the first 3 turns of combat; immune to Paralysis.
Righteous — full; Tainted — only the first bonus; Apostate — silent. With this god's Amulet: +5 max HP. With his Robe: Resting heals 25% more. All together + Heavenly Shield — Divine Spirit: All healing +50%.
Shown number — blessing strength (2 full, 1 dimmed, 0 silent).
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-AMULET_OF_HEARTH_MOTHER.d: Amulet of the god's set (Shrine, 120 gold). With the Blessing of Hearth Mother while Righteous: +5 max HP.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ROBE_OF_HEARTH_MOTHER.des: Robe (body), [gold]Ward[/gold] 2 (Shrine, 150 gold). With the Blessing of Hearth Mother while Righteous: Resting heals 25% more.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BLESSING_OF_THRESHOLD_WAR:
Plating +1; Frost Resistance I. Incompatible with necromancy.
Righteous — full; Tainted — only the first bonus; Apostate — silent. With this god's Amulet: Frost Resistance I; +1 damage to undead and the Abyss. With his Robe: Plating +1. All together + Heavenly Shield — Divine Spirit: Immune to Freeze.
Shown number — blessing strength (2 full, 1 dimmed, 0 silent).
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-AMULET_OF_THRESHOLD_WARDE: Amulet of the god's set (Shrine, 120 gold). With the Blessing of Threshold Warden while Righteous: Frost Resistance I; +1 damage to undead and the Abyss.

Shown number — blessing strength (2 full, 1 dimmed, 0 silent).
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-AMULET_OF_MERCY_SHIELD.de: Amulet of the god's set (Shrine, 120 gold). With the Blessing of Mercy Shield while Righteous: +2 damage to undead and the Abyss.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ROBE_OF_MERCY_SHIELD.desc: Robe (body), [gold]Ward[/gold] 2 (Shrine, 150 gold). With the Blessing of Mercy Shield while Righteous: Plating +1.

Shouts deal 3 more damage; Shock Resistance I.

Shown number — blessing strength (2 full, 1 dimmed, 0 silent).
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-AMULET_OF_THUNDER_CROWNED: Amulet of the god's set (Shrine, 120 gold). With the Blessing of Thunder-Crowned while Righteous: Shock Resistance I; +1 max ◆.

SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BLESSING_OF_SUN_ARCHER.de:
Radiance 2: your attacks against undead and the Abyss deal 2 extra light damage.
Righteous — full; Tainted — only the first bonus; Apostate — silent. With this god's Amulet: Radiance +1. With his Robe: Magic Resistance I. All together + Heavenly Shield — Divine Spirit: Aura: undead and the Abyss get Magic vulnerability I.
Shown number — blessing strength (2 full, 1 dimmed, 0 silent).
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-AMULET_OF_SUN_ARCHER.desc: Amulet of the god's set (Shrine, 120 gold). With the Blessing of Sun Archer while Righteous: Radiance +1.

SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ROBE_OF_SUN_ARCHER.descri: Robe (body), [gold]Ward[/gold] 2 (Shrine, 150 gold). With the Blessing of Sun Archer while Righteous: Magic Resistance I.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-HERO_RECORD.title: Hero's Chronicle
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-HERO_RECORD.description:
Level {Level} (renown {Renown}, {ToNext} to the next level). Unspent: {StatPoints} stat and {SkillPoints} skill points — spend them at camp ([gold]Train[/gold]). Skills learned: {Skills}. Meals: {Fed}. Travel Fatigue: {Fatigue}. Soul stones: {Stones}.
Renown: 1 per combat, 3 per elite, 6 per boss. Shown number — level.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-HERO_RECORD.flavor: Every scar has a line in it.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-RADIANT_CUIRASS.title: Radiant Cuirass
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-RADIANT_CUIRASS.descripti:
Heavy body armor IV. Start each combat with 4 [gold]Ward[/gold]. Sign of the Paladin Path.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SPIKED_HELM.title: Spiked Helm
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SPIKED_HELM.description:
Heavy helm IV. Start each combat with 2 [gold]Riposte[/gold]. Sign of the Black Knight Path.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-REGIMENT_BANNER.title: Regiment Banner
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-REGIMENT_BANNER.descripti:
Cloak. [gold]Poise[/gold] +1. Sign of the Champion Path.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-HORNED_HELM.title: Horned Helm
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-HORNED_HELM.description:
Light helm. +1 max ◆. Sign of the Barbarian Path.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MONK_WRAPS.title: Hand Wraps
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MONK_WRAPS.description:
Hands. Start each combat with 1 [gold]Dodge[/gold]. Sign of the Monk Path.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FACELESS_MASK.title: Faceless Mask
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-FACELESS_MASK.description:
Head. Start each combat with 1 [gold]Dodge[/gold]; +1 ◆ regeneration. Sign of the Assassin Path.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-VIAL_PENDANT.title: Vial Pendant
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-VIAL_PENDANT.description:
Amulet. Poison Resistance I. Sign of the Blightbringer Path.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-RUNIC_QUIVER.title: Runic Quiver
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-RUNIC_QUIVER.description:
Cloak. +2 max ✦. Sign of the Mystic Archer Path.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ELEMENT_STAFF.title: Elemental Staff
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ELEMENT_STAFF.description:
Staff. +3 max ✦, +1 ✦ regeneration. Sign of the Element Lord Path.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-RUNIC_BRACERS.title: Runic Bracers
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-RUNIC_BRACERS.description:
Light gloves. Start each combat with 2 [gold]Flame Cloak[/gold]. Sign of the Battlemage Path.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MIRROR_SHIELD.title: Mirror Shield
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MIRROR_SHIELD.description:
Shield. Start each combat with 6 [gold]Ward[/gold]. Sign of the Reflector Path.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SPIRIT_BELL.title: Spirit Bell
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-SPIRIT_BELL.description:
Amulet. Summon a spirit wolf (8 HP) at the start of each combat. Sign of the Medium Path.
Shown number — weight; 0 — stowed in the backpack.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-RIGHTEOUS_FORM.title: Righteous
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-RIGHTEOUS_FORM.descriptio: Halo: once per combat below 50% HP — heal 10 and gain 10 [gold]Ward[/gold]. Vow: no Abyssal items (taking one ends the form). Each act boss defeated under the vow — a step: 1 Aura of Fortitude ([gold]Plating[/gold] +1), 2 Heavenly Shield (opens the Divine Spirit). Silent while you are not Righteous. Shown number — step.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-RIGHTEOUS_FORM.flavor: Light does not ask; it answers.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-VAMPIRE_FORM.title: Child of the Night
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-VAMPIRE_FORM.description: Thirst {Thirst}/4, +1 for each combat without feeding ([gold]Bite[/gold]). 0: Regeneration 1, fire vulnerability I. 2–3: attacks +2, fire and light ×1.5, healing −50%. 4: attacks +4, lifesteal 25%, fire and light ×2, heal only by feeding. Night Wings: once per combat below 25% HP — [gold]Intangible[/gold] and a free turn. Feedings: {Feedings} (3 — Blood Lord). While you have this form, you are an [gold]Apostate[/gold].
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-VAMPIRE_FORM.flavor: The night is long, and so is hunger.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-WEREWOLF_FORM.title: Beast Bearer
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-WEREWOLF_FORM.description: [gold]Moon Call[/gold] — transform. Outside the form Regeneration does not work; rest heals 25% less. Every 2 Transformations in won combats — a branch node at camp: Hunter {Hunter}/3, Stalker {Stalker}/3, Alpha {Alpha}/3 (pending: {Pending}). While you have this form, you are an [gold]Apostate[/gold].
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DARK_PACT_FORM.title: Dark Pact
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-DARK_PACT_FORM.descriptio: +4 max ✦; summoning spells cost 1 less ✦; −8 max HP. Defeat the Tomb Guardian to become a Herald. While you have this form, you are an [gold]Apostate[/gold].
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-HERALD_FORM.title: Herald
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-HERALD_FORM.description: Pact: +4 max ✦, summoning −1 ✦, −8 max HP. [gold]Stance[/gold]: your spells apply Plague (2 [gold]Blight[/gold]), Discord (−1 [gold]Strength[/gold]) or Decay (1 [gold]Sunder[/gold]). Wins as Herald: {Wins}/{Required} (the Phylactery event — Lich). While you have this form, you are an [gold]Apostate[/gold].
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-LICH_FORM.title: Lich
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-LICH_FORM.description: Pact: +4 max ✦, summoning −1 ✦, −8 max HP. Bone: −30% max HP, physical damage taken −25%, immune to Poison, Blight and Bleed; heal only by absorption and lifesteal. Death Blast: when your summon falls — 5 magic damage to ALL enemies. While you have this form, you are an [gold]Apostate[/gold].
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-LICH_FORM.flavor: Death is a door. You kept the key.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-PHYLACTERY.title: Phylactery
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-PHYLACTERY.description: Weight 3. When you would die — revive with {Percent}% HP, once per run; then it shatters.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CLOCKWORK_HEART.title: Clockwork Heart
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CLOCKWORK_HEART.descripti: Core: [gold]Plating[/gold] +2; immune to Poison, Blight and Bleed; healing −50%. Each combat starts with an elemental sphere ([gold]Wind-up[/gold] adds more, up to 3). Shock damage to you burns ◆ as well as ✦. Compatible only with the Righteous.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-PALADIN_ESSENCE.title: Essence: Paladin
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-PALADIN_ESSENCE.descripti: [gold]Plating[/gold] +1; undead hit you for 1 less per hit; [gold]Smite[/gold] costs no ✦. Path of the Hero.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BLACK_KNIGHT_ESSENCE.desc: Aura of Fear: enemies lose 1 [gold]Strength[/gold] at the start of every 2nd turn. Your attacks heal 1 per hit. Path of the Hero.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CHAMPION_ESSENCE.title: Essence: Champion
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-CHAMPION_ESSENCE.descript: Heavy attacks (2+ ◆) apply 2 [gold]Stagger[/gold] (half to the [gold]Unshakeable[/gold]). Path of the Hero.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BARBARIAN_ESSENCE.title: Essence: Barbarian
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BARBARIAN_ESSENCE.descrip: Rage: below 50% HP your attacks deal 50% more damage and cost no ◆. Path of the Hero.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MONK_ESSENCE.title: Essence: Monk
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MONK_ESSENCE.description: Unarmed: weapon attacks hit as 4 + level/2; every 3rd applies 3 [gold]Stagger[/gold]. Path of the Hero.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ASSASSIN_ESSENCE.title: Essence: Assassin
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ASSASSIN_ESSENCE.descript: Shadow Step: your first attack each turn strikes from behind for double damage. Path of the Hero.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BLIGHTBRINGER_ESSENCE.des: Your [gold]Poison[/gold] +1 stack; Poison on enemies with [gold]Blight[/gold] does not decay. Path of the Hero.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MYSTIC_ARCHER_ESSENCE.des: Bow and crossbow shots apply the element of your last spell (2 stacks). Path of the Hero.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ELEMENT_LORD_ESSENCE.desc: Choose an element: its signature spell joins your deck; your statuses of that element +1 stack. Path of the Hero.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BATTLEMAGE_ESSENCE.title: Essence: Battlemage
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-BATTLEMAGE_ESSENCE.descri: Any elemental Cloak puts on the other two as well; your attacks add 2 elemental damage (fire → frost → shock). Path of the Hero.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-REFLECTOR_ESSENCE.title: Essence: Reflector
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-REFLECTOR_ESSENCE.descrip: [gold]Ward[/gold] reflects 50% of the spell damage it absorbs back at the caster. Path of the Hero.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MEDIUM_ESSENCE.title: Essence: Medium
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-MEDIUM_ESSENCE.descriptio: +1 summon slot; your summons deal 2 more damage. Path of the Hero.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-REBORN_ESSENCE.title: Essence: Reborn
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-REBORN_ESSENCE.descriptio: No bonus. Once: choose a new background and reset your stat points (spend them again at camp). Path of the Hero.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ACT_LEDGER.title: Road Map
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ACT_LEDGER.description: Remembers the acts of this run. Superbosses defeated: {Superbosses}. Claw Keys: {Keys}. Warmth: {Warmth} fights. Valve relief: {Relief} fights.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ACT_LEDGER.flavor: Marked nodes show Gates, vaults, valves and ley lines.
SLAYTHEREQUIEM-ACT_LEDGER.portalBody: A crimson rift opens where the boss fell. Step through to face the act's superboss (artifact, black soul stone, a Candle once per run)?
